user_story: As a user, I want to fill out the checkout information form so that I can proceed with my order. The form should require my first name, last name, and postal code. If I leave these fields empty and click the 'Continue' button, I should remain on the same page to correct my input.
acceptance_criteria: The form should have input fields with the IDs 'first-name', 'last-name', and 'postal-code'.
The 'Continue' button must be present with the data-test attribute 'continue'.
If the form is submitted without filling in the required fields, the URL must remain https://www.saucedemo.com/checkout-step-one.html.
